_comment: Optional, source-grounded notes for the Architex capability map. Rebuild with python tools/techmap/generate_techmap_v3.py. Notes are explanatory, not independent verification of capabilities or integrations. The map builds without this file.

stickies.text: free-floating note shown at the foot of the map

nodeNotes.tool-id: cursive note drawn beside that node

notes.text: Module status and evidence come from the project registry. Live describes the registry's declaration; this map is not a fresh audit or professional compliance sign-off.
Payments & Escrow needs a configured money-movement provider. Remote Desktop needs its host agent, broker, viewer and allowlist. Both are marked integration_required in the registry.

Columns follow the primary route placement. A module may support additional stages: open its details for the registry's wider stage coverage. Bands show workflow coverage, not verified data connections.
